source_set_definition: Root SOURCE-SET.sha256 covers Ada, GPR, shell/Makefile/toolchain metadata, fixtures and locked vendor files. Docs/evidence excluded to avoid circular hashes. Root MANIFEST.sha256 covers the entire delivered tree except itself.

evidence.reference_scope: Independent reference models, cryptographic fixtures and isolated native ABI checks. NO ADA EXECUTION.
evidence.source_scope: Static/source/shell checks; no Ada parser, compiler, tests or GNATprove was run.

implemented_execution_code: descriptor-relative bounded file operations and CAS
signed durable request admission and ambiguity handling
systemd and Pacemaker pinned-command observation/effect adapters
etcd mTLS CAS maintenance-budget coordination SDK
substantive_remaining_boundaries: native RPMDB ownership import/write and full-distribution package/effect semantics
site-authenticated topology, reservation, physical fencing and semantic-health observers
complete fleet rollout service and deployment/operations integration
application-specific data migrations and backup/restore services
full corruption/offline disaster recovery, compaction and anti-rollback anchors
functional proof coverage of native I/O orchestration and independent production acceptance
runtime_target: Linux x86-64 glibc; kernel/filesystem/native libraries are trusted assumptions, not formally verified by this project

implementation_languages.pure_core: Ada 2022 / SPARK source; proof obligations not discharged
implementation_languages.runtime: Ada with SPARK_Mode Off; Linux/native FFI boundaries explicitly documented
